name: Enkidu
bible: Enkidu is androgynous, tall and slender, with pale FIRED-PORCELAIN skin, a soft oval face, a fine jaw and calm GOLD-GREEN eyes with a knowing look. Fine crack lines of fired clay show at the wrists and at the collarbone. Hair is very long, pale SAGE-GREEN, falling past the waist in a loose braid over one shoulder. Costume: a long IVORY robe with a high collar and wide sleeves tied at the wrists, a long ivory sash wound at the waist, all edged with gold embroidery and a moss-green hem; under it an ivory undertunic and dark moss-olive trousers. NO WEAPON IN THE HANDS: both hands are empty and open. Living GOLD CHAINS coil around both forearms and upper arms and float in slow loops around the hands. On command the chains shoot out of the sleeves and lock RIGID into a straight CHAIN-SPEAR of interlocked gold links about one and a half times his height, tipped with a leaf-shaped gold blade with a jade-green vein, shaped from gilded celadon clay. For guard the chains weave a lattice shield of links in front of the body. Energy and trails: GOLD light with JADE-GREEN glints; the chains glow gold.
design:
- top row: full-body stance facing right with gold chains floating around both empty hands; a three-quarter head close-up; a close view of the chain-spear tip, interlocked gold links ending in the leaf-shaped gold blade with a jade vein
- second row: a palm thrust shooting a rigid chain-spear straight ahead; a low rising chain thrust; a walking pose with the braid and sash swinging; a jump with chains trailing
- third row: a lunge with two braided chains forming one long spear; a mid-air diagonal chain thrust; a plunge with chains driving into the ground and clay spikes bursting up; a guard behind a lattice shield of chain links
- bottom row: a hit reaction; knocked down; a calm victory pose with chains looping slowly around them; the Chains of Genesis, living gold chains bursting from the ground

sheetNotes.idle: No weapon in the hands: both hands are empty and open. Loose gold chains float in slow coils around both hands and forearms, and a small leaf-shaped gold blade tip, linked to the chains, hovers by the right hand without being gripped. Standing guard (frame 5): the chains weave a lattice shield of interlocked gold links in front of the body. The long sage-green hair moves with each breath.
sheetNotes.run: No weapon: the hands stay empty and open in every frame. Gold chains stream back from both arms as he runs, and the long sage-green braid and the ivory sash flow behind him.
sheetNotes.air: No weapon: the hands are empty. The chains and the long hair stream upward, the robe billows, and the gold chains stay loose around both arms and hands.
sheetNotes.dash: The dodge roll wraps the gold chains around the body and they unwind back to the arms at the end. The ground dash is a low glide with chains trailing behind like streamers, and the air dash is the same with the robe snapping behind. Heal frames 7-8 are the standard heal with a small red potion flask.
sheetNotes.hurt: No weapon. A hit loosens the chains but they stay coiled around the arms; in the knockdown the chains lie loose and slack beside him, still around the arms.
sheetNotes.atk-a: The chain-spear is made of interlocked gold links, rigid only while it is thrust, and it is tipped with the leaf-shaped gold blade with a jade vein. Combo strike 1 is a palm thrust out of the RIGHT palm at chest height. Combo strike 2 is a low rising thrust, the left hand swung low and back and the chain-spear sweeping up from knee height to shoulder height. The hands hold nothing between thrusts.
sheetNotes.atk-b: The combo finisher is a lunging double thrust: two gold chains shoot out of the sleeves and braid into one long rigid chain-spear about one and a half times his height, tipped with the leaf-shaped gold blade. Frame 2 is the strongest pose. The aerial attack is a single chain-spear shot forward and down from the right palm.
sheetNotes.atk-c: Plunge: both palms point at the ground and chains shoot point-first beneath the body; on impact the chains are driven into the ground, and celadon clay spikes and gold light burst up. Heavy attack: the chains are wound tight round both arms glowing gold, then one long rigid chain-spear drives forward in a full-power gliding lunge, ending in loose coils and gold motes.
sheetNotes.art: Chains of Genesis, six frames in three beats. Anticipation (1-2): both palms pressed to the ground, gold chains spinning up around the body, then the ground under the right of the cell glows gold. Execution (3-4): living gold chains burst up out of the ground in front and whip toward the opponent, binding a space at the right of the cell in glowing links with jade light at the centre. Recovery (5-6): the chains sink back into the ground, and he stands again with the chains coiling home around the arms. Every effect is kept inside its cell.
sheetNotes.skill: Chain Lash, his own special, not the Rift Art. Anticipation (1-2): 1 left hand raised, palm open; 2 left hand clenched, gold links coiling round the wrist, the arm drawn back. Execution (3-4): 3 the arm snaps forward and a living chain lashes out, uncoiling; 4 the chain at full extension with its tip curling to bind, glowing gold. Recovery (5-6): 5 the chain retracts and the links loosen into coils; 6 back in the fighting stance with the chains floating around the arms. The right hand stays open at the side throughout.
sheetNotes.misc: Skill throw: he flicks a loose gold chain link forward from the fingers. Taunt: a chain loops lazily around him, chin lifted with a faintly amused smile and one hand open. Victory: standing calm, chains looping around him in a slow gold glow, the long hair settling.
sheetNotes.ko: Defeat: he staggers, kneels as the chains slacken, collapses, and lies still with the chains crumbling into clay dust. Intro: he walks in with the chains loose, raises one hand, and a length of gold chain unwinds into a spiral in the air, then he settles into the fighting stance, calm and ready.
sheetNotes.alt-a: THIS SHEET SHOWS HIS/HER SECOND FIGHTING STANCE. In EVERY frame the weapon is its own ARMS turned into weapons of living golden clay: the forearms flow and reshape into a broad clay BLADE, a heavy clay HAMMER fist, or spikes - NOT the usual weapon from the reference images (the costume, face, hair and colours stay exactly as the reference). How it is held: no chains in this stance: the chains are wrapped around the waist, the arms themselves become the weapons.
